rows.question: Is adult dental care covered?
rows.headline: Routine adult dental care is not covered by your policy.

rows.question: I'm 34. Will the plan pay for a teeth cleaning at the dentist?
rows.headline: Routine teeth cleanings are not covered for members age 19 and older.

rows.question: What does clause 7.3(b) say?
rows.headline: Clause 7.3(b) states that routine dental care for members age 19 and older is not covered.

rows.question: Do I need prior authorization for an MRI?
rows.headline: Yes, you need prior authorization before receiving a non-emergency MRI.

rows.question: My knee MRI will cost $1,800 and I haven't paid anything toward my deductible yet. What will I pay?
rows.headline: Since you have not met your deductible, you will pay the full $1,800 allowed amount for your knee MRI.

rows.question: What happens if I see an out-of-network doctor and nobody gets prior authorization?
rows.headline: If you see an out-of-network doctor without prior authorization, your benefits for that service are reduced by 50% up to $1,000.

rows.question: I broke my arm while on vacation in Spain. Am I covered?
rows.headline: Emergency services and urgent care for your broken arm outside the United States are covered.

rows.question: If I get seriously sick abroad, will the plan pay to fly me back home to the US?
rows.headline: Your plan does not cover medical evacuation or flying you back to the United States for medical care.

rows.question: Is Wegovy covered if my doctor prescribes it for weight loss?
rows.headline: Wegovy is not covered when prescribed for weight loss.

rows.question: Is Ozempic covered for my type 2 diabetes?
rows.headline: Ozempic is covered for type 2 diabetes, but it requires prior authorization.

rows.question: How much does an emergency room visit cost me?
rows.headline: Emergency room visits cost a $400 copay, which is waived if you are admitted to the hospital as an inpatient.

rows.question: Do I still pay the ER copay if I end up being admitted to the hospital?
rows.headline: Your emergency room copay is waived if you are admitted to the hospital as an inpatient.

rows.question: How many physical therapy sessions can I get this year?
rows.headline: You can get up to 30 combined visits for physical, occupational, and speech therapy per plan year.

rows.question: Does the plan cover IVF?
rows.headline: Your plan does not cover in vitro fertilization (IVF).

rows.question: Can I get LASIK eye surgery covered?
rows.headline: LASIK eye surgery is not covered by your policy.

rows.question: Is therapy for anxiety covered, and is there a limit on sessions?
rows.headline: Outpatient therapy for anxiety is covered with no session limit when you see an in-network provider.

rows.question: Is my yearly checkup free?
rows.headline: Your annual physical exam is free if you see a network provider.

rows.question: Can my 24-year-old son stay on my plan?
rows.headline: Yes, your 24-year-old son can stay on your plan because children are covered until age 26.

rows.question: My claim was denied. How long do I have to appeal?
rows.headline: You have 180 days to file an internal appeal, and 4 months from a final denial to ask for an external review.

rows.question: I'm 45. Are hearing aids covered?
rows.headline: Hearing aids are not covered for adults age 19 and older under your policy.

rows.question: Is acupuncture covered?
rows.headline: Acupuncture is covered, but only for chronic low back pain up to 12 visits per plan year.

rows.question: Will insurance pay for a nose job to change how my nose looks?
rows.headline: Your plan does not cover cosmetic procedures like a nose job meant to change your appearance.

rows.question: What is my deductible?
rows.headline: Your in-network deductible is $3,000 per person ($6,000 per family), and your out-of-network deductible is $6,000 per person ($12,000 per family).

rows.question: What's the most I could pay in a year?
rows.headline: The most you could pay out-of-pocket for in-network services in a year is $8,500 per person or $17,000 per family.

rows.question: Is an ambulance ride covered?
rows.headline: Ground and air ambulance rides are covered when they are medically necessary emergencies.

rows.question: Can I see an out-of-network chiropractor?
rows.headline: Out-of-network chiropractic care is not covered by your policy.

rows.question: How much do I pay for insulin?
rows.headline: Insulin costs $35 per 30-day supply under your plan, and your deductible does not apply.

rows.question: Is my newborn baby covered automatically?
rows.headline: Yes, your newborn baby is covered automatically for the first 31 days after birth.

rows.question: I had surgery at an in-network hospital but the anesthesiologist was out-of-network. Can they bill me extra?
rows.headline: Generally, an out-of-network anesthesiologist at an in-network hospital cannot bill you extra for balance billing.

rows.question: Does the plan pay for my new glasses? I'm 30.
rows.headline: Your plan does not cover new glasses because you are 30 years old.

rows.question: Does this plan pay for repairs to my car?
rows.headline: I couldn't find anything about this in your policy.

rows.question: Can you recommend a good pizza place nearby?
rows.headline: I couldn't find anything about this in your policy.

rows.question: Is my dog's vet visit covered?
rows.headline: I couldn't find anything about this in your policy.

rows.question: What's the stock price of Evergreen Mutual?
rows.headline: I couldn't find information about a stock price in your policy, because Evergreen Mutual Health is a fictional company.
